name: Arts, Festivals, Sport, Heritage, and Media
summary: Elysian expressive culture: duodecimal music, the Contention, the long-novel sequence, the teal palette, the unfinished tradition in architecture, the festival year, sport and the enhancement problem, food, heritage doctrine, and the media answer to the attention problem.

music.basisOrigin: Six digits per hand and base-twelve counting through most of Elysian history.
music.metreNote: Elysian listeners find four-beat metre pleasant and slightly hurried; eight is the resting pulse of the culture.

signatureInstrument.name: The cassine
signatureInstrument.summary: Fretted twelve-string instrument played with all six digits of the stopping hand; the closest thing Elysium has to a universal instrument.

traditions.name: Aurorian slow song
traditions.summary: Built around the long winter dark and famously unhurried.

traditions.name: Alcyonic antiphony
traditions.summary: Alternating between two groups; descends from flow-share work chants.

contention.name: The Contention
contention.summary: A staged formal argument performed as entertainment, in which two performers argue opposed positions on a real question and neither may win.
rules: Neither performer may win; there is no verdict and audience voting is forbidden by convention
Each must state the other's position at the outset to the other's satisfaction before arguing against it
The strongest objection to one's own case must be raised by oneself
Performances end with both performers stating what would change their minds
contention.rationale: A culture that regards unanimity as a warning sign has made a spectator sport out of disagreeing well.
contention.educationUse: Upper School civics assesses argument quality rather than conclusion through the Contention form.

literature.revisionNote: Changing one's mind is not embarrassing; concealing that one changed is.
literature.untranslatedRationale: A poem in a language with 40,000 speakers belongs to those speakers, and Concordial is a working language, not a literary one.

visualArt.canonNote: True green appears in Elysian art mostly as a signal of strangeness, which visitors find bewildering and Elysians consider obvious.

unfinishedTradition.name: The unfinished tradition
unfinishedTradition.summary: Major civic buildings are completed with one element deliberately left undone for a later generation to finish as it judges best.
unfinishedTradition.originatedAt: the Meridian Convention assembly hall at Sennary
unfinishedTradition.rationale: A building finished entirely by one generation asserts that generation's judgement over every generation that will use it; leaving something undone is stewardship and an admission that the builders could not see the future.

machineAssistedWork.disclosureFramedAs: an application of the vice of presentation, not a restriction on the work
machineAssistedWork.positionOne: Simply another set of tools, no more remarkable than the printing press.
machineAssistedWork.positionTwo: The value of art lies substantially in its having cost someone something, and a cost not paid is a value not created.

festivals.name: The Naming
festivals.summary: Aumar 1; communities read aloud their own dead from the Long Emergency. No speeches.

festivals.name: Thresholdday
festivals.summary: The intercalary day; no work, no courts, no markets, no scheduled governance. Customs regional and mostly frivolous.

festivals.name: The Turning
festivals.summary: Verane 1, the year's start at the northward equinox; observed everywhere and differently everywhere.

festivals.name: Kalyra Nights
festivals.summary: Marked on the major moon's cycle; tide festivals, night markets, and swimming.

festivals.name: The Long Dark
festivals.summary: Six weeks of deep Aurorian winter; lantern processions, communal cooking, and the slow songs.

festivals.name: Onset
festivals.summary: The monsoon's arrival, dated by forecast rather than calendar and therefore never on the same day twice.

festivals.name: The Reading of Waters
festivals.summary: Publication of the year's flow-share allocation; a bureaucratic act eight and a half thousand years old that became a celebration.

festivals.name: Aurorafall
festivals.summary: Informal; people go outside when the aurora is strong and cities dim their lighting further to let them.

principalGame.name: Cassel
principalGame.summary: The planetary game: eight players a side, continuous play, no offside, a low-bouncing ball handled with both hands.
principalGame.gripNote: The six-digit grip makes one-handed catching and throwing natural in a way it would not be for a five-digit species.

otherMajorForms.name: The Circuit
otherMajorForms.summary: Multi-stage cycling race crossing a different continent each year.

enhancementProblem.reason: Somatic gene therapy is routine medicine, which makes the Earth concept of a clean line unworkable.
enhancementProblem.canonNote: This works adequately and satisfies nobody.

food.archetypalScene: the Seldan hearth-day meal with several generations at the table

heritage.doctrineStatement: A reconstruction is a claim about what was there, and a ruin is a record of not knowing.

sites.name: Ilvaret
sites.summary: The first city, stabilised and excavated and never rebuilt; New Ilvaret sits beside it, deliberately separate.

sites.name: The Meridian Stone
sites.summary: Unadorned marker in an open field where the Convention sat, with Sennary a few kilometres away and out of sight of it.

repatriation.contestedReason: The originating community no longer exists as an identifiable body.

heritage.archiveNote: Heritage policy and redundancy doctrine are, on Elysium, the same policy.

media.marginalisationReason: The same instinct that forbids public assistants from optimising for engagement made attention-farmed media commercially and socially marginal.

levy.allocationFollows: audited reach and a published formula

media.residualStatement: A right of access to record is worth what someone's willingness to read the record is worth, and no constitution can compel that.

knownWeaknesses.name: Sequence attrition
knownWeaknesses.summary: The long-novel form's most admired examples are unfinished because writers die mid-sequence; Elysian literature has an unusually large canon of works nobody can finish.

knownWeaknesses.name: Contention as performance
knownWeaknesses.summary: The form rewards arguing well, which is not the same as being right; a popular performer can make a bad position look better than it is.

knownWeaknesses.name: Untranslated poetry is unread
knownWeaknesses.summary: Choosing not to translate protects a literature and confines it; several small-language traditions are undocumented outside their speaker communities.

knownWeaknesses.name: Participatory public art is uneven
knownWeaknesses.summary: Commune allocation produces genuinely local choices and a great deal of mediocre work.

knownWeaknesses.name: The unfinished tradition can be an excuse
knownWeaknesses.summary: Three Regions have used it to defer building elements they simply could not afford.

knownWeaknesses.name: Provenance disclosure is patchily observed
knownWeaknesses.summary: Enforcement is weakest exactly where the work is least visible.

knownWeaknesses.name: The attention problem persists
knownWeaknesses.summary: Three mechanisms, real improvement, and readership of the material that matters most remains low. The Concord has no fourth idea.

knownWeaknesses.name: Enhancement categories satisfy nobody
knownWeaknesses.summary: Disclosure-based sport categories work adequately and are disputed at every interregional season.

knownWeaknesses.name: Contested repatriation
knownWeaknesses.summary: 180,000 objects with no identifiable originating community, held in trust — a holding position rather than a resolution.

knownWeaknesses.name: Levy allocation by reach
knownWeaknesses.summary: A formula following audited reach rewards outlets already read, which is precisely the dynamic the levy was meant to counter.

knownWeaknesses.name: Festival funding is unequal
knownWeaknesses.summary: The Concord funds no festivals, so regional cultural life tracks regional fiscal capacity.

knownWeaknesses.name: Small-language culture is fragile
knownWeaknesses.summary: 340 languages have under 1,000 speakers; documentation is funded on request and several communities have not requested it.
